parsed.evidence_quote: we leveraged our previously characterized Ba/F3 cell system that was engineered to stably express the BCR-ABL oncogene (p190 variant) cloned in-frame with BirA*.
After overnight incubation with 50 μM biotin, Ba/F3 cells expressing BirA*-BCR-ABL p190 were lysed...

parsed.value: BioID vs APEX (IMS-APEX2 vs NES-APEX2) and biotin-based click chemistry (O-GlcNAc via thiamet-G + GalT1/PNGase F + DIBO biotin alkyne)
parsed.evidence_quote: We demonstrate the utility of BioSITe when applied to proximity-dependent labeling methods, APEX and BioID, as well as biotin-based click chemistry strategies for identifying O-GlcNAc-modified sites.
The fractionated peptides were analyzed on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass spectrometer
Mass-spectrometry analysis was carried out in a data-dependent manner
MS/MS scans were acquired by fragmenting precursor ions using the higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) method
Higher energy collisional dissociation was set to 32 for MS/MS.
fragment mass error tolerance of 0.02 Da
peptide mass error tolerance of 10 ppm
All experiments described in this study were performed as three independent replicates from the same starting material (process replicates).
